create_validation_set: create a Validation instance with a list of Benchmarks to evaluate agent performance during training
iterate_validation_benchmarks: iterate over validation benchmarks by calling benchmarks_iterator on a Validation instance with a CompilerEnv
iterate_validation_uris: iterate over validation benchmark URIs by calling benchmark_uris_iterator on a Validation instance with a CompilerEnv
wrap_env_for_validation: wrap a CompilerEnv with CycleOverBenchmarks using wrap_env to cycle over validation benchmarks on each reset
validate_benchmarks_field: validate and auto-convert benchmark data into Benchmarks instances via the pre validator on the benchmarks field
